# yt-insights

Local-first Python CLI for turning YouTube channels, playlists, videos, and
existing transcript corpora into searchable structured intelligence.

Repository: https://github.com/FlorianBruniaux/youtube-video-insights
Package: yt-insights
Python: 3.11+
License: MIT

## Primary workflows

1. Analyze a source with an LLM:
   `yt-insights run SOURCE`
2. Import an existing corpus without an LLM:
   `yt-insights catalog import-corpus CORPUS_ROOT`
3. Discover video metadata without downloading media:
   `yt-insights catalog discover SOURCE`
4. Search the local catalog:
   `yt-insights catalog search QUERY [--source SLUG] [--limit N]`
5. Audit local state:
   `yt-insights catalog stats`
   `yt-insights catalog errors [--run-id N]`

The default catalog is `output/catalog.sqlite3`. Generated output and the
database are gitignored. Use `--db PATH` to override the database path.

## Module map

- `src/yt_insights/cli.py`: Click command surface.
- `src/yt_insights/downloader.py`: yt-dlp subprocess adapter and structured
  discovery/download results.
- `src/yt_insights/cleaner.py`: VTT text cleaning. Preserve its existing
  behavior when extending ingestion.
- `src/yt_insights/analyzer.py`: transcript-to-insight LLM pipeline.
- `src/yt_insights/reporter.py`: aggregate reports.
- `src/yt_insights/shorts.py`: Short suggestions and clip extraction.
- `src/yt_insights/catalog.py`: SQLite schema, corpus import, discovery
  ingestion, FTS5 search, run history, and durable collection errors.
- `src/yt_insights/config.py`: defaults, TOML, environment variables, and CLI
  override merge.
- `scripts/build_index.py`: Markdown/YAML index generation for `output/`.
- `runbook/run-channel.sh`: repeatable full-channel ingestion.

## Catalog data model

- `videos`: canonical row per YouTube video ID.
- `video_sources`: many-to-many source membership.
- `artifacts`: transcript and insight files, language, path, searchable text,
  and SHA-256 identity.
- `ingestion_runs`: one auditable row per import or discovery command.
- `collection_errors`: exact source, stage, item, and diagnostic.
- `video_search`: SQLite FTS5 index over title, sources, insight text, and
  cleaned transcript text.

Corpus import is idempotent. Re-importing unchanged files creates an audit run
but does not duplicate videos or artifacts. Expected file-level failures are
recorded and produce `status=partial`. Database or programming failures roll
back domain writes and produce `status=failed`.

## Insight artifact contract

Insight JSON is the source of truth. The expected keys are:

- `subject`
- `key_points`
- `tools`
- `advice`
- `quotes`

Markdown is rendered from JSON. Writes must remain atomic. Truncated LLM
responses with `stop_reason == "max_tokens"` must never enter the cache.

## Constraints

- Run yt-dlp as a subprocess, never import it as a Python library.
- Never put API keys, cookies, transcripts, generated reports, or SQLite files
  in Git.
- Every channel belongs under `output/<slug>/`; always pass an explicit
  channel output directory.
- Preserve source artifacts during catalog import.
- Prefer deterministic collection, normalization, deduplication, storage,
  scoring, and export. Use an LLM only for semantic classification, speaker
  extraction, summarization, newsletter angles, and optional reranking.
- Keep the MCP layer thin: it must call the same Python catalog service as the
  CLI instead of duplicating storage or collection logic.

## Current state

Implemented:

- yt-dlp collection and transcript download;
- transcript cleaning and structured LLM insights;
- aggregate reports and Short suggestions;
- SQLite catalog and corpus import;
- video/artifact deduplication;
- FTS5 search and source filtering;
- durable run and error history;
- CLI regression tests.

Planned:

- YouTube Data API and channel RSS discovery adapters;
- metadata refresh policy and quota tracking;
- deterministic Tech/Product/AI relevance scoring;
- newsletter selection export;
- MCP server exposing catalog discovery, search, inspection, and export;
- optional semantic embeddings only if FTS5 recall proves insufficient.
